sections.title: Compliant Mechanisms and their Application in Soft Robotics
sections.description: This course provides an introduction to compliant mechanisms, that is, mechanisms that rely on elastic deformation. Compliant mechanisms offer motion and force transmission with fewer parts and simpler manufacturing than their rigid counterparts. New work in soft robotics takes advantage of these mechanisms for creating robots that are robust, adaptable, and safe. At the same time, however, using soft and deformable materials for mechanisms design introduces challenges in modeling, fabricating, and controlling their behavior. This course will cover fabrication methods and associated models used for compliant mechanisms design, as well as considerations for their applications in soft robots. Topics will include: kinematics and mechanics models for elastomeric structures, origami-inspired and metamaterial design, and associated actuation methods. The material will be reinforced with hands-on activities.
